questions.stem: When would you use a transect instead of random quadrat sampling?

options.text: When you want to investigate how organisms are distributed along an environmental gradient
When you want to measure the oxygen content of water
When you want to count the total number of animals in a forest
When you want to study organisms in a pond

questions.explanation: A transect is a line placed across a habitat along which samples are taken at regular intervals. It is used when investigating how the distribution of organisms changes along an environmental gradient, such as from a shoreline up a beach or across a field.
